records.extraction: Use the central measured frequency and its quoted one-standard-deviation total uncertainty; convert MHz to Hz by multiplying by 1e6. If statistical and systematic one-sigma uncertainties are separately quoted, combine them in quadrature.
records.development_exclusion: Not used in the unpublished H-D development benchmark.
